parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the request source. Default value: aegis. Valid values:

aegis: Server Guard edition.
sas: Security Center edition.

Server Guard users must use aegis, and Security Center users must use sas
parameters.help_zh:
请求来源标识，默认aegis，取值：

aegis：安骑士版本。
sas：云安全中心版本。

安骑士用户请使用aegis，云安全中心用户则使用sas
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource directory (Alibaba Cloud account).
You can call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
